verdict.rationale: Linear's own docs explicitly state its GraphQL API 'doesn't have versioning like many REST APIs,' but they do document a deprecation policy: use of the @deprecated schema directive, proactive outreach for breaking changes, and changelog entries tagged [API]. This satisfies the 'documented deprecation policy' half of the story but directly contradicts the 'versioned APIs' half. Missing for 10: an actual versioning scheme (e.g., v1/v2 endpoints or dated API versions), and independent/community corroboration that deprecation notices are reliably honored in practice.
